# BreakPoint Strategies

> Boutique retail strategy and execution firm helping digitally-native CPG and DTC brands
> close the gap between proven online traction and physical retail readiness.

## What we do

BreakPoint Strategies pairs senior-level retail strategy with hands-on execution —
no junior account managers, no agency overhead. We diagnose and fix retail readiness
across five pillars: Digital Shelf & PDP, Retail Media Readiness, AI & Search
Discoverability, Marketplace & Velocity, and Brand & Category Fit.

## Products

- Free Retail Readiness Score: https://breakpointstrat.com/score
- The Playbook (fixed-fee diagnostic + roadmap): https://breakpointstrat.com/playbook

## Founder background

Mason Kesner, Founder & Managing Partner. 15-year career spanning CPG, retail, and
advertising. Founded and scaled Asmbly Agency (2018–2024) to an 8-figure exit —
grew to 30+ employees and 250+ brands across three states, directed $1B+ in
cumulative campaign investments, and established Asmbly as Walmart's premier
third-party content partner, later extended to Amazon, Target, HEB, and Walgreens.
Also currently Client Growth Partner at Adomni (AI-powered programmatic DOOH) and
an advisor to Personify Group on go-to-market strategy for dental industry brands.
Career total: $1B+ in cumulative campaign and media investments managed across CPG
and retail.

## Locations

New York, NY · Austin, TX · Bentonville, AR
